# Canva

> Canva is a comprehensive visual design platform offering templates, tools, and partner integrations across email, presentations, documents, social media, video, print, and web design.

Canva provides an extensive suite of design tools including the Visual Suite with integrated products like Sheets, Docs, Whiteboards, Photo Editor, and specialized solutions for resumes, logos, forms, and websites. The platform connects users with certified partners through its partner directory to extend design capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Canva Visual Suite
- Design Templates
- Email Design
- Presentations
- Social Media Design
- Photo Editor
- Video Creation
- Websites
- Print Design
- Canva Docs
- Canva Sheets
- Whiteboards
- Logo Design
- Resumes
- Partner Network

## Partner Network

- [Find a Canva partner | Canva partner directory](https://partners.canva.com/): Directory connecting users with trusted Canva partners for design solutions and integrations.
